patches.name: Unlock native engine
patches.description: Patches the native engine of the 64-bit ARM build (libd.so) so that it loads on a re-signed APK: the anti-tamper constructor that destroys a global mutex and the library's verification routine, whose failure paths are deliberate SIGILL and SIGSEGV instructions, are neutralised. This is what makes Web Widget Overlay and button emulation work.

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, which unlocks the premium features.
